The project

Learning through research.

As team leader, I directed an AI-driven study of Vietnam’s stock market, from data collection and model training to backtesting and presentation. The project received a Gold Medal at the Silicon Valley International Invention Festival in 2025.

600Days of historical data
3Core stock datasets
GoldSVIIF · 2025
01

Prepare the data

We collected 600 days of historical VPS API data for VIC, VNM, and VCB. The VIC prediction experiment used 10-day and 30-day moving averages, price change, daily price range, and lagged volume.

02

Model and backtest

The VIC experiment used a Decision Tree with a maximum depth of five and a 70% training / 30% test split. A daily price decline of at least 5% forced the predicted signal to ‘no buy’.

03

Account for constraints

Historical Value-at-Risk and portfolio-weight constraints were studied alongside Vietnam-specific trading assumptions, including settlement delays and daily price limits.

Current scope

The poster presents separate prediction, allocation, and historical-backtesting experiments. Their results are shown by configuration below; expected returns from a backtest are not realized investment returns.

Research in detail

Selected experiments from the poster

Each row refers to a distinct experiment. The classifier accuracy, stock allocations, and strategy-backtest figures should be read in their own settings.

ExperimentMethod and scopePoster-reported result
VIC price-direction predictionDecision Tree, maximum depth 5; 70% training / 30% test split; 5% price-drop filter.44% classification accuracy.
VIC / VNM / VCB allocationSharpe-ratio optimization with a maximum of 40% per stock and weights totaling 100%.VIC 35.5% · VNM 40.0% · VCB 24.5%.
Historical risk estimateHistorical Value-at-Risk at 95% confidence for a hypothetical VND 100 million portfolio.The poster reports a 95% VaR of approximately −VND 3,049,146.
Technical-strategy backtestHPG, FPT, and VJC daily prices; comparison of MACD, RSI, Bollinger Bands, moving-average crossover, and Stochastic strategies.The strategy-optimization panel reports expected return 17.54%, volatility 19.03%, and Sharpe ratio 0.921.

Source: AI, Finance, and the Vietnam Stock Market poster — Decision Tree + Stop-Loss, Portfolio Optimization with Risk Controls, Risk Analysis with Value-at-Risk, and Strategy Backtesting & Optimization panels.

Further details

Data scope

The poster documents 600 days of VPS API data for VIC, VNM, and VCB, with moving-average, price-change, price-range, and lagged-volume features for the VIC prediction task.

Leadership and evaluation workflow

As SVIIF Team Leader, Thakorn directed model training, backtesting, and presentation, evaluating Decision Tree signals with a 5% stop-loss, historical Value-at-Risk, and portfolio-weight constraints.
